# Intellect AI

> Free guides, copy-ready prompts and example conversations for nine AI coaching personas (Business Mentor, Money Coach, Productivity Coach, Mindfulness Guide, Psychologist, Negotiator, Language Tutor, Leadership Mentor, Science Explainer). Made by the team behind Zehn, a book-summary app by Safari Group. Available in English, Russian and Arabic.

Key facts about Zehn: 10,000+ book summaries, 15-20 minutes a book (audio and text), Ask AI on every book, and an AI Chat tab with the nine personas above and a model picker (Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Grok; all four on the yearly plan, one on the monthly plan). Free plan: 1 book a day, no AI. Zehn Pro: $9.99/month or $36/year with a 7-day free trial. 50,000+ readers. iOS: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6759160035 Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.audiobook.zehn

The AI Psychologist and Mindfulness Guide are self-help tools, not therapy or medical advice. The Money Coach is not financial advice.

## Coaches (English)
- [AI Business Mentor](https://intellectai.app/en/business-mentor/): Test ideas, price offers and plan the next 90 days of a small business.
- [AI Money Coach](https://intellectai.app/en/money-coach/): Build a budget you can keep, pay off debt and start saving.
- [AI Productivity Coach](https://intellectai.app/en/productivity-coach/): Plan your day, beat procrastination and protect time for deep work.
- [AI Mindfulness Guide](https://intellectai.app/en/mindfulness-guide/): Short breathing, grounding and reflection exercises for busy days.
- [AI Psychologist persona](https://intellectai.app/en/psychologist/): Talk through stress, conflicts and habits in a calm, structured way.
- [AI Negotiator](https://intellectai.app/en/negotiator/): Prepare for salary talks, rent, deals and difficult conversations.
- [AI Language Tutor](https://intellectai.app/en/language-tutor/): Practise conversation, fix mistakes and learn words you'll actually use.
- [AI Leadership Mentor](https://intellectai.app/en/leadership-mentor/): Give feedback, run better meetings and lead a team with confidence.
- [AI Science Explainer](https://intellectai.app/en/science-explainer/): Understand science, health news and big ideas in plain words.

## Guides (English)
- [How to start a book club that lasts](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/how-to-start-a-book-club/): How to start a book club that lasts: size, roles, schedule, rules, picking books and running the first meeting. Works online and in person.
- [Book club discussion questions for any book](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/book-club-discussion-questions/): Ready-to-use book club discussion questions for nonfiction and novels, plus how to use an AI coach to write questions for any book in minutes.
- [Running a book club with summaries](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/book-club-with-summaries/): How busy book clubs use 15–20 minute summaries so everyone can join the discussion, when summaries help and when to read the whole book.
- [How to read more books when you have no time](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/read-more-books/): Practical ways to read more books with a busy schedule: small daily slots, audio on the move, quitting bad books and using summaries to choose.
- [How to remember what you read](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/remember-what-you-read/): Why we forget books and seven methods that help you remember what you read: retrieval practice, spacing, notes, teaching and quizzing yourself with AI.
- [The 52 books a year reading challenge](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/52-books-a-year-reading-challenge/): Can you read 52 books in a year? The real maths, a weekly plan, a simple tracker and honest rules about audiobooks and summaries.
- [How to learn a language with an AI tutor](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/learn-a-language-with-ai/): How to learn a language with an AI tutor: a daily 15-minute routine, the best prompts for speaking, writing and vocabulary, and what AI can't do for you.
- [Claude vs Gemini vs DeepSeek vs Grok for learning](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/claude-vs-gemini-vs-deepseek-vs-grok/): Which AI model is best for learning? Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek and Grok compared for explanations, languages, maths and study, and how to test them.
- [The best book summary apps in 2026: an honest comparison](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/best-book-summary-apps/): Book summary apps compared on languages, library size, length, format, AI and free options: Blinkist, Headway, Shortform, 12min, StoryShots, Zehn and more.
- [Book summary apps in Arabic: an honest comparison](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/best-arabic-book-summary-apps/): Book summary apps in Arabic compared: Wajeez, Durar, Ejaz and Zehn. Library, audio, English option, AI and free plans, from each app's own pages.
- [Book summary apps in Russian: an honest comparison](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/best-russian-book-summary-apps/): Book summary apps in Russian compared: Smart Reading, SummaryLib, Zehn, and MyBook for full books. Library, audio, trials and AI, from their own pages.
- [Book summary apps for non-English speakers](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/book-summary-apps-for-non-english-speakers/): Which book summary apps work in your language? Arabic, Russian, Hindi, Urdu, Spanish, German and more, compared by the languages each app actually offers.
- [Is there a book summary app in Arabic?](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/is-there-a-book-summary-app-in-arabic/): Yes. Wajeez, Durar, Ejaz and Zehn offer book summaries in Arabic, with audio. What each one is best for, in two minutes.
- [Which app summarises books in Russian?](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/which-app-summarises-books-in-russian/): Smart Reading, SummaryLib and Zehn summarise books in Russian; MyBook has full books. What each one is best for, in two minutes.
- [Can AI explain a book to me?](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/can-ai-explain-a-book/): Yes: AI can explain a book's ideas, answer questions and quiz you. How to ask well, what it gets wrong, and apps that put AI on every book.
- [Is there an app to discuss books with other readers?](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/app-to-discuss-books-with-other-readers/): Yes: reading communities, book club apps and summary apps with discussion features. Which kind fits you, and how Zehn's Book Club tab works.
- [The 52 books in 2027 challenge](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/52-books-in-2027/): Join the 52 books in 2027 reading challenge: a month-by-month theme plan, the Friday finish rhythm, a free tracker and a printable sheet. Start 1 January.
- [How people read in 2026: Arab, Russian and English-speaking readers](https://intellectai.app/en/guides/reading-statistics/): How much do people read in 2026? Cited figures for Arab, Russian, US and UK readers from the Arab Reading Index, VTsIOM, Pew, the NLT and UNESCO.
- [What is Zehn?](https://intellectai.app/en/zehn/): What Zehn is, who makes it and what it does: 15–20 minute book summaries, Ask AI on every book, an AI Chat with coaches, Book Club, languages and plans.
- [How Zehn makes your day easier](https://intellectai.app/en/zehn/daily/): Seven everyday moments where Zehn helps: the commute, lunch, a meeting, a hard conversation, language practice, Sunday planning and winding down.
- [The Zehn Book Club, explained](https://intellectai.app/en/zehn/book-club/): How the Book Club tab in the Zehn app works: join topic clubs, post your take on a book, reply to other readers and take part in club challenges.
